Where

Three cities. One movement.

East, South and West: each market has NFL hometown teams, huge youth populations and the venues to deliver a big-league experience.

New York City

Home of the Giants and Jets
  • About 1.7 million people under 18 (20.2%)
  • The largest media market in the U.S.
  • Teams already back the NYC PSAL

Dallas

Home of the Cowboys
  • Ranked #2 city for football fans
  • Dallas ISD: 8 stadiums, 22 high schools, 400+ events a year
  • Around 7,362 high school student athletes

Los Angeles

Home of the Rams and Chargers
  • 275,069 student athletes on 9,809 teams
  • 19.2% of the population is under 18
  • Immense major-event infrastructure
InterdependenceTeams, stadiums, sponsors, hotels and transit working together.
Geographic ReachWest, East and South reach youth across the country.
Emotional ValueHometown teams turn a one-day camp into a lasting connection.
Community ChannelsSchools and youth groups help reach our 12–18 market.

Questions

Good to know

Do I need football experience?

No. The camp is built for beginners and experienced players alike.

Does it cost anything?

No. The camp, game ticket and swag bag are free for selected youth.

How are participants chosen?

Camp spots go to 300 randomly selected registrants per city, based on city preference. Game tickets go to 300 lottery-selected nominees per city.

Who can take part?

Youth ages 12–18 in the New York City, Dallas and Los Angeles markets.
